description:
You are the Office Manager at Northwind Traders. You want to automate the categorization of the monthly rent payments to your landlord, 'Downtown Properties'.

Your task has two parts:
1. Navigate to Settings -> Chart of Accounts and create a new expense account named 'Rent Expense' (Code: 6200, Group: Expenses).
2. Navigate to Settings -> Bank Rules and create a new Bank Payment Rule. Configure it to match the description 'Downtown Properties' and automatically allocate the payment to the 'Rent Expense' account.

Save both the account and the rule.
